purpose: Provenance and disjointness audit for the APPS-derived 257-task development set used to select the resource-oriented shared dimension.

source.selection: First 257 source-order tasks without fn_name and with at least five unique short string-I/O tests; converted to solve(input_str)->str with two visible and up to twenty hidden tests.

audit.audit_definition: Unicode NFKC normalization, lowercase conversion, and whitespace collapse followed by SHA-256. This is an exact normalized-text audit, not a semantic near-duplicate detector.
